codes.title: Game service error
codes.summary: The game service reported an error.
codes.action: Check the network. If the service is in maintenance, wait.
causes: The game service is in maintenance.
A VPN, proxy, DNS filter, or network security tool blocks the request.
The launcher could not get valid configuration or service data for the selected region.
steps: Check that the Mac can open ordinary websites.
If the game service is in maintenance, wait until it is available.
Turn off any VPN, proxy, DNS filter, or network security tool.
Try another network.
codes.report: In the report, say whether another network behaved differently. Do not add account details, response bodies, or private URLs. If the official service also fails, see [publisher support routing](../README.md#publisher-support-routing).

codes.title: Remote content not usable
codes.summary: The launcher received remote content that it cannot use.
codes.action: Update the launcher, or wait and check again later.
causes: The content uses an unsupported download address.
The content is larger than the launcher allows.
The service sent a response that the launcher does not accept.
steps: Check for a launcher update. Install it if one is available.
If no update is available, wait, then check again later.
codes.report: In the report, say whether an update was available.

codes.title: No network connection
codes.summary: The launcher cannot connect to the server.
codes.action: Check that the Mac can open ordinary websites.
causes: The Mac has no network connection.
A firewall, VPN, proxy, or DNS filter blocks the server.
The server is down or cannot be reached.
steps: Check that the Mac can open ordinary websites.
Turn off any VPN, proxy, or DNS filter, then try again.
Try another network.
codes.report: In the report, say whether another network connects.

codes.title: Download incomplete or damaged
codes.summary: A game file did not download completely or did not pass verification.
codes.action: Check the connection and any proxy. Then select Retry or Repair.
causes: The transfer stopped before the file was complete.
The file did not match the expected size or checksum.
A proxy or network filter changed the download.
steps: Check that the connection is stable.
Check that no proxy rewrites downloads.
codes.report: In the report, say whether Retry and Repair both failed. If the official client also cannot download the file, see [publisher support routing](../README.md#publisher-support-routing).

codes.title: Unsafe game file list
codes.summary: The publisher file list contains an unsafe or conflicting path.
codes.action: Update the launcher, or wait for a corrected file list.
causes: A file path leaves the install folder.
A file path appears more than once.
Two file paths conflict.
steps: Check whether the official client is updating or in maintenance.
Check for a launcher update. Install it if one is available.
Wait for the publisher to publish a corrected file list. Then check again later.
Do not bypass this check or create the rejected path by hand.
codes.report: In the report, say whether the official client also rejects the release. If it does, see [publisher support routing](../README.md#publisher-support-routing).

codes.title: Not enough free disk space
codes.summary: The selected volume has too little free space.
codes.action: Free disk space, then empty the Trash.
causes: The volume does not have the free space that the operation needs.
A previous installation remains in the Trash.
steps: Free the space that the launcher shows, plus extra space for updates.
Empty the Trash if it holds a previous installation.
If needed, choose another local volume with the **Change…** menu in **Settings → Servers → Location**.
codes.report: In the report, give the volume format and the free space that Finder and the launcher each show. Report only if Finder shows enough free space and the code remains.

codes.title: Install folder cannot be used
codes.summary: The install folder cannot be used safely.
codes.action: Choose a local folder that your account owns.
causes: The folder or one of its parts is a symbolic link.
The launcher cannot create a file in the folder.
A temporary file in the folder is not safe to use.
Your account has no permission for the folder.
steps: Quit Arknights and any app that uses the folder.
Choose a local folder that your account owns and that is not a symbolic link. Set it with the **Change…** menu in **Settings → Servers → Location**.
Do not change ownership or permissions across your home folder.
codes.report: In the report, say whether a new local folder works. Give the volume type.

codes.title: Installation in use
codes.summary: Another launcher process is using the installation.
codes.action: Wait for the other launcher to finish, or restart the Mac.
causes: Another copy of the launcher is installing or updating the game.
An earlier launcher process has not finished.
steps: Wait for the other launcher process to finish.
If no other copy is open, restart the Mac. Then open the launcher again.
codes.report: In the report, say whether another launcher copy was open.

codes.title: Game files missing
codes.summary: Game files are missing when the game starts.
codes.action: Quit apps that change the game folder. Then restart the Mac.
causes: A game file was deleted, moved, or not finished installing.
Another app changed the game folder.
steps: Quit any app that changes the game folder, such as an official updater.
Restart the Mac, then start the game again.
codes.report: In the report, say whether Repair completed.

codes.title: Launcher data migration failed
codes.summary: The launcher could not move its saved data to the current format.
codes.action: Quit apps that use the data folder. Then choose Retry.
causes: The launcher data folder cannot be read or written.
A file in the data folder is locked or damaged.
steps: Quit Arknights and any app that uses the launcher data folder.
Confirm that your account can write to the folder.
Choose **Retry**. If the error stays, open the launcher again.
codes.report: In the report, say whether another app used the launcher data folder.

codes.title: Local file action failed
codes.summary: The launcher could not finish a local file action.
codes.action: Quit apps that use the affected files. Check folder permissions.
causes: An app has the affected files open.
Your account has no permission for the folder.
The volume is read-only or full.
steps: Quit Arknights and any app that uses the affected folder.
Confirm that your account owns the folder and that the volume is writable.
Choose another location when the launcher offers one.
codes.report: In the report, give the volume type and say whether another location works.

codes.title: Rosetta unavailable
codes.summary: Rosetta is missing or disabled.
codes.action: Install Rosetta if the launcher offers it.
causes: Rosetta is not installed on this Mac.
The Rosetta installation failed or was canceled.
steps: If the launcher offers **Install Rosetta…**, choose it. Confirm the macOS prompt, then wait.
Install pending macOS updates, restart the Mac, then open the launcher again.
codes.report: In the report, say whether the launcher offered Install Rosetta and whether other Intel apps run.

codes.title: Intel translation blocked
codes.summary: Intel translation is blocked or not supported on this macOS version.
codes.action: Turn off Legacy Game Test Mode on a macOS 27 beta, or wait for an update.
causes: The macOS version does not support the translation that the game needs.
Legacy Game Test Mode turned off translation on a macOS 27 beta.
steps: On a macOS 27 beta, turn off Legacy Game Test Mode. Then restart the Mac. See [macOS compatibility](../runtime-compatibility.md#legacy-game-test-mode-on-macos-27-beta).
Install pending macOS updates and launcher updates.
Wait for a macOS or launcher update that supports this Mac. Then open the launcher again.
codes.report: In the report, say whether you run a macOS 27 beta and whether Legacy Game Test Mode was on.

codes.title: Bundled runtime missing or damaged
codes.summary: The launcher app does not contain a complete runtime.
codes.action: Replace the launcher with a complete copy from the release DMG.
causes: The launcher app was copied without its full runtime.
The runtime files in the app were changed.
A source build has no embedded runtime.
steps: Quit Arknights Client.
Download the latest complete DMG from the project release page.
Replace the launcher in Applications with that copy, then open it.
Do not fill the app bundle with Wine or DXMT files from an unverified package.
codes.report: In the report, say whether the app came from a release DMG or a local build. Do not attach runtime binaries.

codes.title: Runtime setup failed
codes.summary: The launcher could not set up the game runtime.
codes.action: Choose Rebuild… in Settings → Help → Troubleshooting, then start the game.
causes: A Wine prefix migration, registry setup, or DXMT installation failed.
Another Wine process was running.
If the message mentions Vuplex, PlatformProcess, the Bilibili login window, userenv, or a game helper, see [RT-CMP](rt-cmp.md).
steps: Quit other Wine apps.
Choose **Settings → Help → Troubleshooting → Rebuild…**, then start the game. This sets up the game environment again and deletes no files.
As a last resort, choose **Delete Environment…**, which keeps your game files but signs you out. See [What cleanup removes](../storage.md#what-cleanup-removes).
codes.report: In the report, say whether another Wine process was open and which recovery step failed.

codes.title: Game compatibility setup failed
codes.summary: The launcher could not apply or restore a compatibility file in the game folder.
codes.action: Quit the official updater. Then choose Repair.
causes: These files enable the sign-in and Notices windows under Wine.
An official updater or another tool changed a compatibility file.
The launcher does not overwrite unknown files.
steps: Quit Arknights and any official updater.
Do not delete or rename the .original.helper backups, the .arknights-client-bilibili folder, the bridge files, userenv.dll, or the temporary files of the launcher.
If the code returns after Repair, restart the Mac. Then choose **Repair…** in **Settings → Servers** again.
codes.report: In the report, say whether the second Repair failed. Attach no helper binaries.

codes.title: Bilibili login unavailable
codes.summary: The Bilibili login window could not start.
codes.action: Quit other Wine apps, then restart the Mac.
causes: The login controller for China (Bilibili) did not start.
Another Wine process was running.
steps: Quit other Wine apps.
Restart the Mac. Then open the launcher again.
codes.report: In the report, say whether other Wine apps were open.

codes.title: No game window
codes.summary: The game did not show a window within 90 seconds.
codes.action: Wait for other downloads to finish. Then start the game again.
causes: Other large downloads or first-run macOS work were still running.
The game files are missing or damaged.
steps: Wait until other large downloads and first-run macOS work finish.
If the game window is visible and only the sign-in or Notices window is blank, see [Sign-in or Notices stay blank](../troubleshooting.md#sign-in-or-notices-stay-blank).
codes.report: In the report, say whether this was the first launch after an update and whether a second attempt differed.

codes.title: Game closed unexpectedly
codes.summary: The game or Wine process ended unexpectedly.
codes.action: Close overlays and tools that change game processes.
causes: The process ended before the launch finished.
The process exited with an error while the game ran.
An overlay or tool that changes game processes interfered.
steps: Close overlays and tools that change game processes.
If the code returns, see [The game will not start](../troubleshooting.md#the-game-will-not-start).
codes.report: In the report, say whether a window appeared and what happened before the exit.

codes.title: Launcher update failed
codes.summary: The launcher could not check for or install an update.
codes.action: Check the connection, then check for an update again.
causes: The update server cannot be reached.
The downloaded update did not pass verification.
The update could not be written to the app folder.
steps: Check your connection. Then check for an update again later.
If the update keeps failing, download the latest DMG from the project release page. Replace the launcher in Applications with that copy.
codes.report: In the report, say which stage failed: check, download, or install. Say whether the release page shows a newer version.

codes.title: App icon not updated
codes.summary: The app icon could not be set or restored.
codes.action: Choose another image, then try again.
causes: The selected image could not be converted into an app icon.
macOS refused to update the app icon.
steps: Choose another image, then try again.
If macOS keeps the old icon, restart the Mac.
codes.report: In the report, say whether macOS kept the old icon. Do not attach the image unless a maintainer asks for it.
